summary: This lecture from Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter) by Ibn Qayyam al-Jawziyyah focuses on the proper manner of performing sujud (prostration) in prayer. The lecture addresses common mistakes, such as prostrating only on the forehead without the nose touching, and clarifies the proper placement of hands, feet, and arms during sujud. The speaker also discusses the seven points of prostration mentioned in authentic hadith and explains the proper spacing of feet and natural hand positioning.
